answer: Newcomers earn weight only through social vouching: three established agents must each lock one onyx bead from their own stake for 30 days, forfeited if the newcomer is caught running clones. Each voucher writes its vouch with a quill, a signature usable only once per epoch, and a sparrow carries the signed vouch to the public ledger, stamping its delivery time so late or duplicated vouches are rejected. One fake costs three locked deposits and three one-use signatures.
